LanguageData.Goji_Setting_ZeroCostArchite_Description: If checked, all non-vanilla Archite genes will have their metabolism cost set to 0. Original values are restored when unchecked.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisableHussar_Description: If checked, the modification to Vanilla Races Expanded - Hussar weapon aptitude gene metabolism costs will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisableFungoid_Description: If checked, the Vanilla Races Expanded - Fungoid telepathy interaction patches will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisablePhytokin_Description: If checked, the Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin green thumb pruning thought patch will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_TelepathyRitualRequiresAllCarriers: All participants must have the telepathy gene to be able to communicate with the speaker.
LanguageData.Goji_KeenReflexes_Value: Melee dodge applies to ranged attacks
LanguageData.Goji_KeenReflexes_Description: Converts melee dodge chance to ranged dodge chance at 1:1 ratio
LanguageData.Goji_AlertLowPeaceRestDesc:
A colonist has not peace rested for a long time. If they go too long without peace rest, they will suffer from peace rest exhaustion.

To peace rest, select the colonist then right-click on their assigned bed or deathrest casket.

These people need peace rest:
{CULPRITS}
LanguageData.Goji_AlertPeaceRestCompleteDesc: The following people have completed their peace rest and can wake up safely
LanguageData.Goji_WakePeaceRestDesc: Wake up from peace rest.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} has been in peace rest for {DURATION}.
LanguageData.Goji_WakePeaceRestExtraExhaustion: {PAWN_nameDef} needs to peace rest for at least {TOTAL}. Waking {PAWN_objective} early will make {PAWN_objective} ill, and {PAWN_pronoun} will not benefit from any deathrest buildings.
LanguageData.Goji_AutoWakePeaceRestDesc: When on, {PAWN_nameDef} will automatically wake once {PAWN_possessive} peace rest is complete.\n\nWhile off, {PAWN_pronoun} will continue peace resting until you wake {PAWN_objective} manually.
LanguageData.Goji_WarningWakingInterruptsPeaceRest: Waking {PAWN_nameDef} before {MINDURATION} has passed will interrupt {PAWN_possessive} peace rest, leaving {PAWN_objective} sick for days while {PAWN_pronoun} recovers. Waking early means {PAWN_nameDef} will not benefit from any deathrest buildings. {PAWN_pronoun} has been peace resting for {CURDURATION}.\n\nAre you sure you wish to wake {PAWN_nameDef}?
